gaps: P0, P1: no candidates. P2 has only the 1674 Maschius prospect (#2, #3 are portraits). P3: only one strong general view (the 1815 Torvet watercolor #4 is two years later). P4: the photochroms (#7–#9) show the Leirfoss waterfalls outside town.
notes: #14/#16 (1955–60 aerials, snow) are an alternative for P5. P6 alternatives: #18 (Brattørkaia waterfront with the Powerhouse building, sharper but no historic landmarks), #20 (2023 aerial in snow and cloud). The 1892 print’s photographer is not named in the record.
